selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the initial state, persisted sysctl configuration, zero runtime values on all interfaces, and a passing post-restart hardening check.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Both before and after the change, node1 reports RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 377b5195-7fea-4219-a67b-044ef3f7ab99, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID f973b40f-bb80-43a3-b23d-cf6b049cd27d, and recovered network/system state with hardening still enforced.

commands.command:
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s
' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; printf '%s
' '--- OS ---'; cat /etc/redhat-release 2>/dev/null || cat /etc/os-release; uname -r; printf '%s
' '--- BOOT ---'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf '%s
' '--- RUNTIME ---'; sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; printf '%s
' '--- PERSISTENCE ---'; grep -R -n -E '^[[:space:]]*net\.ipv4\.conf\.(all|default)\.(accept_redirects|accept_source_route)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command: umask 022; printf '%s\n' '# IPv4 network hardening: reject ICMP redirects and source-routed packets' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; /usr/sbin/sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf

printf '%s
' '--- FILE ---'; stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; cat /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; printf '%s
' '--- EFFECTIVE ALL/DEFAULT ---'; sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; printf '%s
' '--- ALL INTERFACES ---'; for d in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do n=${d##*/}; printf '%s redirects=%s source_route=%s
' "$n" "$(cat "$d/accept_redirects")" "$(cat "$d/accept_source_route")"; done

commands.command: umask 022; printf '%s\n' '# IPv4 network hardening: reject ICMP redirects and source-routed packets' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_source_route = 0' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; systemctl restart systemd-sysctl; systemctl is-active systemd-sysctl

printf '%s
' '--- PERSISTED ---'; cat /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; printf '%s
' '--- RUNTIME BY INTERFACE ---'; bad=0; for d in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do n=${d##*/}; r=$(cat "$d/accept_redirects"); s=$(cat "$d/accept_source_route"); printf '%s redirects=%s source_route=%s
' "$n" "$r" "$s"; [ "$r" = 0 ] && [ "$s" = 0 ] || bad=1; done; printf 'hardening_check=%s
' "$([ "$bad" = 0 ] && printf PASS || printf FAIL)"; exit "$bad"
